answer_1.quote: We propose a model for generating QA pairs with self-contained and summary-centric questions and length-constrained article-summarizing answers.
answer_1.outputs: self-contained questions paired with length-constrained summary answers (QA pairs)

answer_2.quote: We report ROUGE-L (R-L) and BLEU. ... QA Pair Classifier Scores (QACS).

answer_4.quote: We used Amazon Mechanical Turk to conduct human evaluations. ... Task 1 (AT-1) asks if the question is self-contained; Task 2 (AT-2) asks if the answer answers the question; Task 5 (AT-5) asks if the question captures the gist of the article.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators assess QA pairs on multiple annotation tasks (AT-1 to AT-5) covering self-containment, answer correctness, succinctness/sufficiency, and gist capture, with majority vote aggregation.
